data.name: Bird Game 3 Online
data.detailed_description:
Dive into high-speed aerial combat and prove you’re the fiercest bird in the skies! Pick your favorite species, team up with other players, and battle it out in chaotic real-time matches where quick thinking and skill make all the difference.

ACTION-PACKED MULTIPLAYER

Fast online battles across vibrant sky arenas

Snatch eggs from enemy nests and bring them home to score

Use dodges, boosts, slams, and clever maneuvers to outplay rivals

Climb the ranked ladder and show everyone who rules the air

A CAST OF UNIQUE BIRDS

Hummingbird – lightning-quick strikes and rapid bursts (gonna nerf soon)

Eagle – heavy-hitting predator with brutal dive attacks

Crow – deceptive trickster with unpredictable movement

Sparrow – nimble all-rounder, perfect for new players

…plus many more birds waiting to be unlocked!

FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS

Real-time competitive PvP matches

Multiple modes: Aerial Skirmish, Nest Defense, Egg Hunt

Customize your bird with skins, flight trails, and emotes

Explore forest cliffs, rocky mountains, and canyon maps

Built-in voice chat for coordinated team play

RISE TO THE TOP

Advance from Bronze to Legendary, join clans, compete in tournaments, and cement your legacy in the Bird Game Online Hall of Fame.

data.short_description: You are a bird. Fly around, steal eggs, protect your nest, and fight other birds. Play in PvP or team up in Co-Op modes.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Indonesian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8000 MB available space

  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 12
